doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Rowe thanks DeJohnette and ends the recording.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well you’ve had a marvelous career, you came a long way from your first piano teacher that used to whack your knuckles if you didn’t do it right

And you’ve entered that world of being an influencer, because we always talk about our influences and I know that you’ve influenced a lot of people in a positive way so I want to thank you for your time today.
Right. Thank you. It was a pleasure.
Yeah thank you I’ll stop recording here and we’ll say a quick good-bye. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
